summary: You now hear about every time a safety guard protects your data.

new.title: See every safety guard that steps in
new.text: When a guard holds something to protect your data, you get a mail, it shows under Jobs, and it is recorded in the audit trail.

fixes.title: Status telemetry on by default
fixes.text: Status telemetry to Invardia is now on by default. You can switch it off under Settings > Features.

fixes.title: Clearer AD group creation errors
fixes.text: When the hybrid worker cannot create new AD groups, the message now names the missing right and the group to grant it to.
